name: Sentinel Farsong
summary: At Silverwing Grove, Sentinel Farsong helps defend Ashenvale’s southern border. She rallies champions against the Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch.

sections.title: Guardian of Silverwing Grove
sections.body: Sentinel Farsong keeps watch at Silverwing Grove as the Warsong clan cuts lumber and advances into night elf lands. She calls Alliance champions to strike at Warsong Outriders and sends field reports to Silverwing command. Her work helps check the Horde’s expansion and protect the woods.

faq.answer: Sentinel Farsong is a night elf sentinel with the Silverwing Sentinels in Ashenvale. She is stationed at Silverwing Grove near the entrance to Warsong Gulch, where she recruits Alliance adventurers and gathers battle intelligence.
Sentinel Farsong can be found at Silverwing Grove in southeastern Ashenvale, where the Alliance stages its efforts in Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Why is she fighting the Warsong Outriders?
faq.answer: The Warsong Outriders are harvesting timber and defiling Ashenvale’s sacred forests. Sentinel Farsong helps defend the woods and recover territory claimed by the Horde.

angles.text: Sentinel Farsong directs Alliance volunteers in the fight against the Warsong Clan in Ashenvale.
As a protector of Elune’s sacred woods, Sentinel Farsong reflects the kaldorei’s resolve to drive out those who defile the ancient groves.
